about_the_game:
In the 21st century, a profession called virtual anchor began to rise on the internet. Anchors showed their talents and brought happiness to netizens with their talents. DD also enthusiastically supported their favorite anchors and supported their activities. However, the good times did not last long. A strange virus began to spread on the internet, called the F (FaFa) D (Madness) virus, which would spread along the network cable. Countless DD viewers who were watching the live stream were brutally infected! Infected individuals will gradually become cybermaniacs who go crazy 3 times a day for 8 hours each time!

How can this continue like this! To save the DDs, virtual anchors stepped forward! They decided to liberate their own power! Evolve with love (physics) DDs!

Main features:

  • This is a free fan game where you play as your favorite virtual anchor and use their unique character skills to defeat a constant stream of enemies! There are dozens of game characters, and new anchor characters are regularly updated!

  • The weapon is preset for automatic shooting, just control the character's movement and find the right moment to release the ultimate skill, easy to pick up and fast paced!

  • The game consists of 20 rounds, each lasting 20-90 seconds, where players must find ways to defeat more enemies and survive within the time limit. After the enemy is defeated, they will become your fans and leave a fan badge! Please note: At the end of the countdown, an invincible super tube will appear and steal your light badge! Please evacuate quickly from the safe passage!

  • Purchase various powerful weapons and props with light cards during the intervals of each round! There are dozens of weapon props in total, try various combinations, and try to form the strongest combination!

  • After defeating the enemy, you can obtain rice coins. Use rice coins to recruit new anchor characters or strengthen the initial abilities of anchors on the training page! Extracting duplicate anchors will speed up their must kill skill charging speed. Elevating the anchor to full level can also unlock exclusive images and set them as the cover of the homepage~

  • There are some anchors marked with defeat tags, and using them to defeat can unlock defeat CG that makes people take action! Of course, some anchors may even unlock handsome victory CG after winning!

If you are a live streamer, you can experience the gameplay of live streaming by turning on the live streaming mode switch above the character selection page! This gameplay requires manual operation. Starting from the 6th round, there will be an interactive session where whenever a fan gives a gift, simply click the designated button to summon powerful enemies! The increased difficulty is precisely the love of fans, survive under the love of fans! come on.

content_descriptors.notes: Using some characters to challenge levels and fail will unlock the character's defeated CG, where the character's clothes will be damaged and a large area of skin will be exposed (without revealing)
